description: Integration between Guidewire and the third-party telematics provider is dropping 15-20% of incoming driving score payloads. Affected policies are not receiving their safe-driver discount adjustments. The issue appears intermittent and does not produce any error logs on the Guidewire side.
resolution_notes: The telematics provider updated their payload schema to include a new required field 'deviceFirmwareVersion' which Guidewire's integration adapter was not mapping. Unmapped required fields caused the adapter to silently discard the payload rather than raising an error. Updated the integration adapter mapping config to pass through the new field, added a dead-letter queue to capture and alert on any future unmapped payloads, and reprocessed the dropped payloads from the provider's retry queue.

description: Nightly batch job that calculates commission payouts for agents failed to run for the second night in a row. Agents are asking about missing commission statements. The job's log shows it starts but terminates after a few seconds with no clear error written to the application log.
resolution_notes: The batch job was failing because a scheduled database maintenance window overlapped with its start time, causing it to lose its connection mid-initialization. The job's connection retry logic was not configured to handle this case. Added a retry-with-backoff wrapper around the initial connection step and rescheduled the maintenance window to avoid the overlap. Reran the job manually for both missed nights and all commission statements were generated correctly.

description: Underwriters across all regions report that the risk scoring widget on the submission screen shows 'N/A' instead of a score for every new commercial submission since this morning. No error message, just a blank score.
resolution_notes: 3rd party risk scoring API changed their response schema without notice -- they renamed 'risk_score' field to 'score_value'. our widget was still reading the old field name so it got null every time. updated the parsing code to read the new field name and added a fallback to the old name in case they revert. confirmed scores are showing again for new submissions.

description: Claim payments to vendors are being rejected by the bank integration. The error message from the bank API says the routing number format is invalid. This started after the bank updated their API to require a 9-digit zero-padded format. Approximately 85 vendor payments are stuck in pending state.
resolution_notes: The outbound payment integration was formatting routing numbers without zero-padding, sending 8-digit numbers when the bank now requires 9 digits. Updated the routing number formatter in the payment gateway integration adapter to always zero-pad to 9 digits. Reprocessed the 85 stuck payments and confirmed all were accepted by the bank.

description: The monthly commission reconciliation report shows a few agents with negative commission balances that don't match any actual chargeback.
resolution_notes: traced to a timing bug where a commission reversal from a cancelled policy and the original commission payout were being counted in the wrong reporting month for a handful of edge-case policies cancelled right at month-end. adjusted the report's month-boundary logic to use the transaction effective date consistently. reran the report for the affected month, balances now correct.

description: Loss reserves calculation is producing incorrect totals for catastrophe claims filed after Hurricane Milton. The reserve amount shown in the claims dashboard is significantly lower than what adjusters are entering manually. This is impacting financial reporting and reinsurance calculations.
resolution_notes: Investigation revealed the CAT (catastrophe) flag was not being applied to the reserve calculation formula for claims filed via the mobile intake portal. The portal was sending claims without the CAT event code, so the standard (non-CAT) reserve multiplier was used instead. Fixed the mobile intake API to include the CAT event code from the event registry, and triggered a recalculation job for all 312 affected Milton claims.

description: All premium disbursements to agents have stopped processing since this morning. The disbursement batch job runs but produces zero output with no error. This is blocking all agent commission payments for the current cycle, affecting over 400 agents.
resolution_notes: A certificate used by the disbursement service to authenticate to the payment processor expired overnight. The service was silently skipping the payment step rather than failing with an error when the certificate was rejected. Renewed the certificate, restarted the disbursement service, and re-ran the batch job. All 400+ agent payments processed successfully on the re-run.

description: Payment plan reassignment is failing for policies that were migrated from the legacy billing system. When an agent tries to change the payment plan on a migrated policy, BillingCenter throws a foreign key constraint violation. Agents can manually recreate the policy in BillingCenter as a workaround but it takes 30 minutes per policy.
resolution_notes: Migrated policies were missing a required payment_plan_template_id reference because the legacy system used a different identifier scheme. The migration script had not mapped the legacy plan codes to the new BillingCenter template IDs. Added the missing template ID mappings to the migration reference table and ran a backfill for all 312 affected migrated policies.

description: Agents in the commercial lines team are unable to log in after 2pm every day. The session expires immediately upon login. The issue started after a configuration change was pushed to the SSO provider last Thursday. Personal lines agents are unaffected.
resolution_notes: The SSO provider configuration change had set the session timeout to 2 minutes for the commercial lines user group instead of 480 minutes. This caused immediate session expiry on login for that group. Corrected the session timeout value in the SSO provider admin console and confirmed all commercial lines agents could log in successfully.

description: Claims department is reporting that claim payment checks are printing with the wrong payee name. The payee field on printed checks shows the claimant's policy number instead of their full legal name. Approximately 40 checks printed incorrectly this week before the issue was caught.
resolution_notes: The check print template in BillingCenter was referencing the wrong field binding -- it was pulling policy_number into the payee name field instead of contact_display_name. The template binding was corrected and the 40 affected checks were voided and reprinted with the correct payee names.

summary: Auto-pay enrollment fix pending QA validation
description: Customers enrolling in auto-pay via the self-service portal were silently failing to be linked to the correct payment plan in BillingCenter. A fix has been coded and deployed to QA; validation is in progress before production release.
resolution_notes: The payment-plan linkage call was using the account's old plan ID cached at login instead of re-fetching the current plan. Fixed to always fetch the live plan ID. Currently under QA validation, not yet released to production.

summary: User asking why invoice total doesn't match quote - expected behavior
description: Agent opened a ticket saying invoice amount is 'wrong' but amount correctly includes a mid-term endorsement premium change.
resolution_notes: No defect. Explained proration logic to agent and linked existing Billing Proration FAQ runbook. Closed as user error.

description: Refund checks for cancelled policies are being calculated with the wrong pro-rated amount in a small number of cases.
resolution_notes: Root cause appears to be a rounding discrepancy in the pro-ration formula for policies cancelled mid-billing-cycle. Proposed fix is in QA, awaiting sign-off from finance team before closing.

description: The nightly disbursement batch job has been failing silently for 3 days. No error is surfaced in the UI but the job log shows a NullPointerException in DisbursementPlugin.gs at line 142. Payments that should have gone out on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday have not been issued. Claimants are calling in about missing payments.
resolution_notes: The DisbursementPlugin.gs was referencing a payment account field that is null for older claims created before the 2025.1 migration. Added a null check before accessing the field. Re-ran the batch job manually for the 3 missed days and confirmed all outstanding disbursements were issued.

description: Adjuster unable to attach photos to a claim from the mobile app -- upload button spins forever and never completes. Works fine on desktop for the same claim.
resolution_notes: mobile app was hitting an old file-upload endpoint that was deprecated last release. nobody updated the mobile config. pointed mobile app config to the new endpoint url. verified upload works on iOS and Android.

description: Loss run report generation is timing out for accounts with more than 500 claims. The report page shows a loading spinner and then returns a timeout error after 30 seconds. Smaller accounts are unaffected. This is blocking renewal underwriting for three large commercial accounts. The loss run query was doing a full table scan without using the claim count index, which performed acceptably for small accounts but degraded severely above 500 claims. Added the missing index hint to the report query and rewrote the aggregation to paginate instead of loading all claims into memory. Tested with a 1200-claim account and confirmed the report now generates in under 3 seconds.
resolution_notes: SME reviewed and approved via Operations Hub UI.
summary: Loss run report timing out for large accounts; query optimized with index and pagination.
Still being triaged, not yet actionable
description: New claim intake form occasionally submits duplicate claim records when the user double-clicks submit. Root cause not yet confirmed.
resolution_notes: Not yet resolved -- actively being investigated.

description: Adjusters are unable to close claims in ClaimCenter after the 2026.2 upgrade. The close button is visible but clicking it throws a Gosu runtime error: ClaimContact.getActiveRoles() method not found. Only affects claims with multiple claimants. Single-claimant claims close normally.
resolution_notes: The method ClaimContact.getActiveRoles() was renamed to ClaimContact.getRolesByStatus() in Guidewire 2026.2. Updated the custom CloseClaimWorkflow.gs rule to use the new method name. Redeployed and confirmed multi-claimant claims close correctly.

description: Adjuster notes are failing to save when claims have more than 50 attachments. Adjusters can work around this by splitting notes into smaller entries or removing older attachments temporarily. The issue is intermittent and affects roughly 20 active large-loss claims.
resolution_notes: A file descriptor limit in the attachment service was being hit when claims exceeded 50 attachments. The service was not releasing file handles after each attachment preview load. Fixed by adding explicit handle cleanup in the attachment service and raising the per-process file descriptor limit in the server config. All 20 affected claims were verified as able to save notes after the fix.

description: All claim adjusters are unable to log into ClaimCenter starting this morning. Login attempts hang for 30 seconds then return an authentication timeout error. PolicyCenter and BillingCenter logins are unaffected. Every adjuster across all regions is impacted and claims work has stopped.
resolution_notes: The ClaimCenter authentication service was pointed at an identity provider endpoint that had been migrated to a new URL during an infrastructure change the previous night, but ClaimCenter's configuration still referenced the old endpoint, which was timing out instead of returning a clean error. Updated the identity provider endpoint configuration in ClaimCenter to the new URL and restarted the authentication service. All adjusters confirmed able to log in within minutes.

description: Claim notes entered by adjusters were being truncated at 500 characters when saved, cutting off important details on longer claims.
resolution_notes: the claim notes field had a legacy varchar(500) limit that was never widened when the UI started allowing longer notes. altered the column to text type and redeployed. confirmed long notes save in full now.

summary: Nightly batch job ClaimReserveRecalc failing with timeout
description: ClaimReserveRecalcBatch has failed for 3 consecutive nights. Job exceeds the 2-hour SLA window and is auto-killed by the scheduler. Claim volume has not changed significantly.
resolution_notes: Found a missing index on cc_claim.cg_lastreservedate after a DBA-led table partitioning migration last week. Added composite index (claim_id, lastreservedate). Batch runtime dropped from 3h10m to 22m.

description: A handful of claims are showing an incorrect adjuster assignment after the nightly reassignment batch job runs.
resolution_notes: Suspect the round-robin assignment logic has an off-by-one error when the adjuster pool size changes mid-cycle. Fix drafted, pending code review before deployment.

description: Agent reports a customer's mailing address shows correctly in ContactManager but printed policy documents still use an old address from 2 years ago.
resolution_notes: doc gen template was pulling address from a cached snapshot table that only refreshes nightly, not live from contactmanager. customer had updated their address same-day so cache hadn't caught up yet. no code change needed -- explained caching behavior to agent, address appeared correctly on next day's doc run. closing as no action by design, will revisit nightly refresh frequency separately if this comes up again.

description: Duplicate contact records are being created when the same customer calls in through two different channels (phone and web portal) within the same day. This is causing policy correspondence to be sent twice to the same customer. Support has identified 60 duplicate pairs created in the last week.
resolution_notes: The contact matching logic only checked for an exact match on email address, but the web portal submission used a different email casing than the phone channel's recorded email, so the dedup check failed. Updated the contact matching rule to normalize email case before comparison, and merged the 60 existing duplicate pairs using the merge-contacts utility.

description: Agents are reporting that searching for contacts by phone number returns no results even when the number exists in the system. The same contact is found correctly when searching by name. This started after last Friday's maintenance window and is affecting all agency staff.
resolution_notes: The maintenance window included a database index rebuild. The phone number search index was rebuilt with the wrong collation setting (case-sensitive instead of case-insensitive), and phone number formatting normalization was skipped. Numbers stored as (555) 123-4567 were not matching queries for 5551234567. Rebuilt the index with correct collation and added a normalization step in the search query to strip formatting characters before lookup.

summary: Duplicate contact records created after sync with external CRM
description: Integration job from Salesforce into ContactManager is creating duplicate Contact entities instead of matching existing ones when email address has different casing (John@x.com vs john@x.com).
resolution_notes: Matching logic in ContactMatchSet was case-sensitive on email. Applied config change to normalize email to lowercase before match. Ran de-dup batch script to merge ~340 existing duplicates.

summary: Users unable to log in - license limit reached
description: New hires in the call center cannot log into ContactManager, getting 'no license available' error.
resolution_notes: Concurrent user license pool was exhausted by orphaned sessions from a prior VPN outage that never cleaned up. Ran session-cleanup script to release stale licenses and requested a license headroom increase from Guidewire account team as preventive measure.

description: Duplicate contact merge is creating corrupted records for contacts linked to both a policy and an open claim. After the merge completes, the surviving contact record shows null values for address and phone. The original records are deleted so the data cannot be recovered from the UI.
resolution_notes: The merge logic was not handling the case where a contact had active links in both PolicyCenter and ClaimCenter simultaneously. It was merging the PolicyCenter-side fields correctly but then overwriting them with nulls from an incomplete ClaimCenter-side merge pass. Fixed the merge sequence to consolidate all linked records before writing the final merged contact. Recovered the corrupted contacts from a database backup and re-ran the merge with the fixed logic.

summary: Customer portal shows misaligned button on mobile Safari
description: The 'Pay Now' button on the billing page overlaps the due-date text on iPhone Safari after last week's UI release.
resolution_notes: Pure CSS flex-wrap issue in the new responsive billing component. Cosmetic only, no functional impact. Fixed padding rule and redeployed static assets.

description: Customers trying to reset their portal password via the 'forgot password' link report the reset email never arrives.
resolution_notes: outbound email relay for password resets had hit its daily sending quota with the 3rd party email provider due to unrelated marketing campaign traffic sharing the same relay. moved password-reset emails to a dedicated relay with its own quota. confirmed emails arriving within seconds now.

description: Some customers report the 'Make a Payment' button on the portal homepage is unresponsive on first click and requires a second click to work.
resolution_notes: Suspected a JS event binding race condition on page load. A candidate fix has been written and is being validated by QA before this ticket is closed.

description: Customers attempting to download their policy declaration PDF from the self-service portal receive a blank page instead of the document. The download link itself works correctly when tested in a different browser. Only affects customers on the latest version of one specific browser.
resolution_notes: A recent browser update changed how that browser renders embedded PDF viewers for cross-origin documents. The portal's PDF viewer component was serving the file without the correct content-disposition header for that browser's new security model. Updated the header configuration so the PDF downloads directly instead of attempting an inline render for that browser.

description: Outbound policy data feed to the reinsurance partner is failing. The file transfer completes but the partner's system rejects the files due to a changed field delimiter. Reinsurance team can manually export and send data as a workaround. Around 3 daily feeds have failed since Monday.
resolution_notes: The reinsurance partner changed their file format spec to use a pipe delimiter instead of comma without prior notice. Updated the outbound feed configuration to use the pipe delimiter. Confirmed with the partner that the next scheduled feed was accepted successfully.

summary: Outbound claims payment file to bank rejected - format error
description: Daily claims payment extract to the bank's SFTP has been rejected for the last 2 runs with a format validation error on the payment file.
resolution_notes: Bank changed their fixed-width file spec (field 14 widened from 10 to 12 chars) per their advisory sent 2 weeks ago to a distro list that didn't include our team. Updated IntegrationGateway mapping template to match new spec. Added bank advisory distro to our change-notification subscription.

summary: SFTP file drop failing for vendor data exchange
description: Nightly SFTP file transfer to third-party vendor failing with 'connection reset' errors. Approximately 40 files failed to transfer over 3 nights, causing a backlog in downstream processing.
resolution_notes: Vendor had rotated their SFTP host key without notice; our client was rejecting the new key via strict host checking. Updated known_hosts and added a monitoring alert for host key changes. Backlog reprocessed successfully.

description: Outbound claims data feed to the reinsurance partner occasionally sends a record twice within the same batch.
resolution_notes: Likely a retry mechanism re-sending a record after a timeout, without checking whether the original send actually succeeded. Fix proposal under review by the integrations lead.

description: Outbound policy data files to the reinsurance partner (PartnerRe) have stopped arriving on their SFTP server since yesterday. No errors visible in the Guidewire UI. The integration log shows the files are being generated but the SFTP upload step is timing out after 30 seconds.
resolution_notes: The PartnerRe SFTP server had rotated its host key over the weekend without notifying us. The known_hosts entry in our integration server was stale, causing the connection to be refused silently. Updated the known_hosts file with the new host key and confirmed the next scheduled file transfer completed successfully.

summary: Second wave of stuck submissions, same symptom as INC-100234
description: Additional underwriting team reporting identical hang on bind. Same deployment window.
resolution_notes: Duplicate of INC-100234. Same Gosu rule fix applied once patch rolled out to remaining app servers.

summary: Users intermittently logged out every 5 minutes
description: Multiple users across regions report being logged out of PolicyCenter roughly every 5 minutes since this morning. No recent deployment on our side.
resolution_notes: Traced to SSO identity provider session token TTL being reduced from 60 to 5 minutes by the IAM team during an unrelated security hardening change. Not a Guidewire defect. Coordinated with IAM to revert TTL to 60 minutes for the PolicyCenter service principal.

description: New business policy submission is completely blocked for all commercial lines agents nationwide. When agents attempt to submit a new policy, the submission fails immediately with a 500 error. The issue started at 8am this morning after the overnight deployment. No workaround exists and business is at a standstill.
resolution_notes: The overnight deployment included a Gosu rule change that introduced a syntax error in the commercial lines submission validation script. The error caused the submission service to crash on every request. Rolled back the Gosu rule to the previous version. All agents confirmed able to submit policies after rollback.

description: Complete PolicyCenter outage across all regions. All app server threads blocked. MIM bridge opened.
resolution_notes: Thread dump analysis showed deadlock between the new audit-logging interceptor (added in 2025.2.1) and the document-generation service under high concurrency. Rolled back audit-logging interceptor via feature flag as immediate mitigation; permanent fix tracked as a vendor-escalated defect (case GW-88213) with a patch expected in 2025.2.2. RCA-2025-041 filed.

description: Endorsement effective date validation is rejecting valid future dates for homeowners policies. Agents entering an endorsement effective date more than 30 days in the future receive a validation error saying the date is out of range, even though the product rules allow up to 90 days. This started after last week's product configuration update.
resolution_notes: The endorsement date range validator had a hardcoded 30-day maximum that was not updated when the product team extended the allowed window to 90 days in the product configuration. Updated the validator to read the allowed date range from the product configuration rather than a hardcoded constant. Confirmed agents can now enter endorsement dates up to 90 days in the future.

summary: Follow-up question on PolicyCenter outage RCA
description: Ops lead asking for confirmation the audit-logging feature flag rollback is holding steady post-incident.
resolution_notes: Confirmed stable for 24h post-rollback. No action needed, informational closure referencing RCA-2025-041.

description: Underwriters report that the premium calculation is returning incorrect values for commercial auto policies. The quoted premium is consistently 12-15% lower than expected. Personal auto policies are unaffected. Issue appeared after a configuration change pushed last Thursday.
resolution_notes: Identified that the commercial auto rating factor table (CommercialAutoFactors) had an incorrect multiplier entered during last Thursday's config update -- a decimal was misplaced (0.88 instead of 1.088). Corrected the value in the rating configuration and reran affected quotes. No code change required.

description: Policy renewal workflow is failing at the final submission step. When an agent clicks 'Bind Policy', the system throws a NullPointerException in the premium calculation service. This affects all auto policies in the Texas region. Agents are unable to complete renewals and customers are receiving error pages.
resolution_notes: Root cause was a null handling bug introduced in the premium rounding utility (PremiumRoundingUtil.java) during the previous sprint. The null check was missing when the base rate table returned an empty row for Texas-specific surcharges. Added null guard in PremiumRoundingUtil, redeployed to production, and ran a backfill job to reprocess the 47 failed renewals.

description: Premium rating for commercial auto policies is producing results that differ from the manual rate calculation sheet by 3-8%. The difference appears only on policies with more than 5 vehicles. Underwriters are manually checking and correcting premiums before binding.
resolution_notes: The commercial auto rating Gosu rule was applying a fleet discount tier using a 0-indexed lookup instead of 1-indexed, causing the wrong tier to be selected for multi-vehicle policies. For a 6-vehicle policy it was using the 5-vehicle tier rate. Corrected the index offset in the Gosu rule and redeployed. Identified 14 bound policies with incorrect premiums and initiated endorsements to correct them.

summary: Policy renewal batch job failing silently
description: Nightly policy renewal batch job completes with exit code 0 but no renewal notices are generated. No errors in logs. Affects ~200 policies due for renewal this week.
resolution_notes: Found a swallowed exception in the renewal notice generator's try/catch block. Added proper error logging and fixed the null-check on policy holder email. Batch now correctly generates and logs failures.

description: Policy documents generated for umbrella policies are missing the endorsement schedule page. Agents have noticed the omission on delivered documents. Customers can be sent a corrected document manually on request but the generation itself is producing incomplete PDFs.
resolution_notes: The document assembly template for umbrella policies was missing a conditional include for the endorsement schedule section. The section was present in all other policy types but had been accidentally removed from the umbrella template during a recent template cleanup. Restored the endorsement schedule section to the umbrella template and regenerated documents for the 18 affected policies issued in the last 30 days.

description: New business submission for commercial auto policies is taking over 2 minutes to complete, compared to the usual 10-15 seconds.
resolution_notes: Investigating whether the slowdown correlates with the new underwriting rule deployed last week. Narrowed down to a specific rating table lookup. Fix is being tested in staging.

summary: Rate engine returning stale rates after table update
description: After the quarterly rate table update, new quotes are still using the previous quarter's rates for about 15% of risk classes. Cache invalidation logic has been patched and is currently soaking in staging before rollout.
resolution_notes: Rate cache wasn't being invalidated per risk-class key, only globally. Patch adds per-key invalidation on table update. Currently in staging soak test, not yet promoted to production.

summary: Auto rating returns incorrect premium for multi-car discount
description: QA flagged that policies with 3+ vehicles are not receiving the multi-car discount since the 2025.2.1 rate table update.
resolution_notes: Rate routine MultiCarDiscountRule.gs had an off-by-one error in the vehicle count comparison (used > 3 instead of >= 3) introduced during the rate table refactor. Code fix deployed and backtested against 50 sample quotes.
